entities.summary: Patrice Nganang (b. 1970, Yaoundé) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yaoundé and Cameroon. Known in the fields of cameroon, authors & novelists, africa.
